title: The console has its own language setting
description:
As a newsroom member, I want the console in my language, independent of the languages the site publishes, so I can work comfortably.

Design (Ryan's decision 12): a per-person setting; interface strings in a catalog per language with plural rules through Intl.PluralRules; app/layout.tsx lang follows the setting. Sequenced after Spanish is public. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450), revised 2026-11-12 with Ryan's decisions.

Feature: Console language

Scenario: A Spanish-speaking editor uses the console in Spanish
  Given an editor chose Spanish as their console language
  When they open the newsroom
  Then the console's menus and buttons are in Spanish
  And the Stories they edit keep their own languages
